english.title: Knowingly / recklessly supply false / misleading information to another knowing it will be given to a housing authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) supplied false or misleading information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..) to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), knowing that the information was to be used for the purpose of supplying information to **(..SPECIFY LOCAL HOUSING AUTHORITY..), the local housing authority, in connection with its functions under Part **(..SPECIFY PART..) of the Housing Act 2004 and knowing or being reckless as to whether it was false or misleading.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 238(2) and (3) of the Housing Act 2004.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
supplied info to another person which was false or misleading
knew it was false or misleading / was reckless as to whether it was false or misleading and
knew the info was to be used for purpose of supplying info to a local housing authority
in connection with any of their functions under any of Parts 1 to 4 or Part 7

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Offence start date in Wales: 16th June 2006
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant supplied false or misleading information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..) to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), knowing that the information was to be used for the purpose of supplying information to **(..SPECIFY LOCAL HOUSING AUTHORITY..), the local housing authority, in connection with its functions under Part **(..SPECIFY PART..) of the Housing Act 2004 and knowing or being reckless as to whether it was false or misleading.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
